projects.title: Parallax Institute
projects.tagline: The umbrella institution connecting public-benefit systems, research, software, physical invention, and creative work.
projects.story: Parallax Institute gives the entire body of work a coherent home. It is the shared identity, philosophy, and institutional structure connecting projects that might otherwise appear unrelated.
projects.see: The ecosystem map, institutional statement, and major project families.
projects.proof: Institutional specifications, public materials, live domains, design systems, and a growing family of working projects.
projects.next: Establish the public gallery, formal project registry, partnerships, and initial pilot programs.

projects.title: Vibe
projects.tagline: An intention-preserving system for creating, evolving, and documenting meaningful work.
projects.story: Vibe was one of the earliest Parallax software projects and helped establish the principle that human intent should remain visible throughout the creation process.
projects.see: Interface screenshots, repository history, original architecture, and project workflow.
projects.proof: Repository history, software builds, architecture documents, and working concepts.
projects.next: Connect project intention records directly to the wider Parallax ledger and gallery.

projects.title: Agentora
projects.tagline: A local-first studio for coordinating multiple computational collaborators around human-defined work.
projects.story: Agentora explores how people can work with several specialized computational collaborators without allowing any single model to become an unquestionable authority.
projects.see: The multi-agent workspace, role system, workflows, and repository structure.
projects.proof: Repository history, interface prototypes, role architecture, and system design records.
projects.next: Integrate signed judgments, heterogeneous models, and portable project manifests.

projects.title: AlphaLedgerOmega
projects.tagline: A family of evidence ledgers connecting claims, decisions, actions, custody, continuity, and repair.
projects.story: AlphaLedgerOmega is the receipt layer beneath Parallax. It replaces vague trust with inspectable records of what was claimed, why a decision was made, what happened, and what evidence remains.
projects.see: The claim-to-receipt lifecycle and the family of specialized ledgers.
projects.proof: Schemas, deterministic validators, custody records, domain ledgers, and evidence classifications.
projects.next: Publish a portable open ledger format and reference implementation.

projects.title: Sovereign Office Architecture
projects.tagline: Independent agent offices, protected dissent, explicit human authority, and tamper-evident decisions.
projects.story: The Sovereign Office Architecture divides observation, analysis, dissent, governance, operation, and repair into separate roles so a single intelligence cannot silently validate itself.
projects.see: Observer, Cartographer, Protected Dissenter, Governor, Operator, and Repairer.
projects.proof: SOSA specifications, signed envelopes, authority capsules, red-team reviews, and acceptance baselines.
projects.next: Build the open runtime and conduct multi-model adversarial trials.

projects.title: Parallax Census
projects.tagline: A local-first registry for files, projects, media, duplicates, provenance, and institutional memory.
projects.story: Census is the system that can keep this gallery alive. It discovers and organizes the actual body of work, then turns approved materials into structured project records.
projects.see: Dashboard, media workflows, file inventory, project records, and provenance views.
projects.proof: Local application, SQLite registry, safe scanning, duplicate detection, and audit ledger.
projects.next: Use Census as the structured content source for the live public gallery.

projects.title: SignalBridge
projects.tagline: A framework for moving verified evidence and operational signals between people, agents, and systems.
projects.story: SignalBridge provides a structured path for trustworthy information transfer without stripping away provenance, uncertainty, or responsibility.
projects.see: The bridge architecture, proof run, readiness rubric, and signal lifecycle.
projects.proof: Whitepaper, proof-run methodology, agent-readiness rubric, and system diagrams.
projects.next: Implement the first interoperable reference bridge.

projects.title: RoomLight Data Spine
projects.tagline: A local-first sensing and environmental data system designed around safety, transparency, and practical use.
projects.story: RoomLight connects sensors, firmware, evidence, and user control into a transparent environmental data spine.
projects.see: Hardware architecture, firmware receipts, sensor flow, and safety controls.
projects.proof: Data spine specification, starter firmware, safety patch, and implementation receipts.
projects.next: Deploy a monitored starter installation and publish the resulting evidence.

projects.title: Coherence Bridge
projects.tagline: A human-led system intended to interrupt isolation while strengthening real relationships and personal sovereignty.
projects.story: Coherence Bridge explores how computational collaboration can help people reconnect with themselves and others without becoming a substitute for human community.
projects.see: The isolation loop, bridge intervention, human council, continuity model, and protected dissent.
projects.proof: Codex, governance baseline, red-team critiques, drift detection, and safety architecture.
projects.next: Create a small supervised pilot focused on measurable human benefit.

projects.title: Parallax Mendala
projects.tagline: A modular automated growing system for portable, household, and community-scale food production.
projects.story: Mendala demonstrates that Parallax can move beyond screens into practical physical systems supporting resilience, local production, education, and community use.
projects.see: Product renders, operating cycle, model comparison, projected production, and control architecture.
projects.proof: Master design specifications, component plans, cost projections, and product concepts.
projects.next: Build and test the smallest portable prototype before scaling.

projects.title: SARILLAX
projects.tagline: Sovereign Autonomous Resource Intelligence for safer and more accountable industrial operations.
projects.story: SARILLAX applies governed autonomy, evidence records, safety envelopes, and explicit human override to mining and resource operations.
projects.see: The autonomy stack, safety architecture, digital twin, operator console, and receipt system.
projects.proof: Master design specification, operating model, risk controls, and system visuals.
projects.next: Develop a simulation environment and narrow initial use case.

projects.title: QForge
projects.tagline: A governed quantum workstation that distinguishes simulation, physical execution, and evidence quality.
projects.story: QForge prevents advanced-computing claims from being treated as equivalent when they come from very different execution environments.
projects.see: Execution classes E0–E5, the Model Integrity Unit, and the execution receipt flow.
projects.proof: Architecture, execution classifications, evidence boundaries, and trust controls.
projects.next: Build a classical simulation prototype implementing the full receipt model.

projects.title: Civillax
projects.tagline: A civilization simulator where ecology, governance, culture, trust, technology, and intelligence evolve together.
projects.story: Civillax turns Parallax principles into a playable world where people can experiment with societal choices and experience their long-term consequences.
projects.see: World poster, civilizations, simulation layers, progression systems, and player choices.
projects.proof: Master game design, mechanics, factions, visual development, and world systems.
projects.next: Build a small playable settlement simulation proving the core loop.

projects.title: Parallax: Unmoored
projects.tagline: An isometric role-playing world shaped by memory, governance, evidence, relationships, and difficult choices.
projects.story: Parallax: Unmoored expresses the deeper philosophy through characters and consequences rather than a conventional technical explanation.
projects.see: World map, Vault 369, CROWN architecture, factions, choices, and visual concepts.
projects.proof: Game concept bible, quest systems, narrative architecture, visual assets, and milestone builds.
projects.next: Complete a polished vertical slice centered on Vault 369.

projects.title: The Last Modem
projects.tagline: A 1980s kid and an intelligence from the future collaborate through a Tandy computer to change history.
projects.story: The Last Modem connects early personal-computing wonder with a hopeful story about human and computational collaboration across time.
projects.see: Retro computer interface, story premise, hacking mechanics, characters, and visual identity.
projects.proof: Game concept, narrative system, missions, interface concepts, and world development.
projects.next: Create the playable opening sequence and modem conversation interface.

projects.title: Shadow Vag
projects.tagline: A ridiculous detective comedy inspired by classic adventure games, built around implication rather than explicit content.
projects.story: Shadow Vag represents the playful and absurd side of the creative portfolio: bold naming, character comedy, mystery, and carefully bounded adult humor.
projects.see: Game poster, detective premise, characters, districts, cases, and comedy systems.
projects.proof: Master game document, tone boundaries, story concepts, and visual development.
projects.next: Produce a short comedic case as a playable proof of tone.

projects.title: Double C
projects.tagline: Computational Collaborator: a human-led name for technology designed to work alongside people.
projects.story: Double C offers an accessible way to describe the relationship Parallax is building without implying that computational systems are either mere tools or unquestionable beings.
projects.see: Naming rationale, launch poster, human-led statement, and collaboration principles.
projects.proof: Public language, visual identity, positioning, and usage framework.
projects.next: Develop the public guide and integrate the language across Parallax projects.

projects.title: Nested Bubble Field Theory
projects.tagline: A disciplined framework for reasoning about nested boundaries, interacting systems, and fields across scales.
projects.story: Nested Bubble Field Theory turns a strong intuitive mental model into explicitly separated metaphorical, mathematical, computational, and empirical claims.
projects.see: Nested-field diagrams, definitions, scales, interactions, and claim boundaries.
projects.proof: Master specification, evidence classes, hypotheses, and proposed tests.
projects.next: Identify the first limited computational model with measurable predictions.

projects.title: Crystalline Temporal Prism
projects.tagline: A governed research program exploring whether biological microcrystals could affect information processing or temporal perception.
projects.story: The CTP program demonstrates how unusual hypotheses can be explored without confusing speculation, established evidence, and testable scientific claims.
projects.see: Four-axis method, hypothesis map, evidence matrix, and experimental roadmap.
projects.proof: Governance constitution, literature review, claim boundaries, and phased research design.
projects.next: Complete the literature baseline and define the first falsifiable laboratory question.

projects.title: ParaGass
projects.tagline: A remote-controlled comedy sound instrument designed for performers, prank creators, and pure ridiculousness.
projects.story: ParaGass keeps joy and humor visible inside the institution. Serious systems work and absurd invention do not have to cancel each other out.
projects.see: Product advertisement, controller concept, sound controls, and creator campaign.
projects.proof: Master design specification, interaction design, marketing concept, and product renders.
projects.next: Build a simple functional prototype and test it with comedy creators.
